Titles.eng: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion!
Titles.jpn: どうも、好きな人に惚れ薬を依頼された魔女です。

Summaries.eng: The Good Witch of the Lake's four-year crush ended in heartbreak with a single request from the object of her affections! Wanting to increase what little time she has with Royal Knight Harij, Rose sends him on a wild-goose chase for the ingredients but gets more than she bargained for when the grumbling knight starts visiting her every day…to feed her?

Aliases: Doumo, Suki na hito ni Horegusuri wo Iraisareta Majo desu
